in_marathi.name: Sohit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sohit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sohit is derived from Sanskrit word 'Soham' which means 'I am the Sun'. This name is believed to bring radiance, success and prosperity in the life of the bearer.

in_bengali.name: Sohit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sun, Radiant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sohit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Sohit is derived from Sanskrit word 'Soham' which means 'I am the Sun'. This name is believed to bring radiance, success and prosperity in the life of the bearer.
